newsitem.title: FRANCE: Credit Foncier takeover result due Dec 9.
newsitem.headline: Credit Foncier takeover result due Dec 9.

text.p: The results of the takeover offer for France's Credit Foncier de France by state bank Caisse des Depots et Consignations (CDC) will be published on December 9, the French stock exchanges association (SBF) said on Monday.

The CDC bank has been asked by the government to make the offer as part of government plans for a gradual winding down of Credit Foncier after huge losses on the back of provisions written into its 1995 accounts.
The offer of 70 francs a share would cost over 2.5 billion francs if all shares were sold. Acceptances covering two-thirds of shares are required for the takeover to take place.
